blocks.title: Art and  Code
blocks.text:
Art + Code is an immersive professional development program, designed to empower U.S.-based educators to bring fundamental software concepts into K-12 art classrooms.
Over the course of the program, participants explore a diverse curriculum that bridges code and art. Using p5.js, a free, open-source platform that makes programming visual and approachable, teachers learn to build interactive artworks, collaborate with peers, and apply computational thinking through artmaking.

blocks.title: Curriculum Overview
blocks.body:
Art + Code invites learners to experience coding as a creative practice. The lessons blend pedagogy with hands-on coding, modeling how creativity and computer science can coexist in learning spaces.

This work is licensed under Creative Commons BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Interested in bringing Art + Code to your school district or region? We’d love to talk to you. Please reach out to [education@processingfoundation.org](mailto:education@processingfoundation.org).
